articles.title: Sandra Bullock Says UFO Sighting Left Her Convinced Invisible Aliens Are ‘Watching And Laughing’ At Us
articles.summary: Sandra Bullock says a UFO sighting left her convinced invisible aliens are "watching and laughing" at us. And she was dead ...
articles.body:
Sandra Bullock says a UFO sighting left her convinced invisible aliens are “watching and laughing” at us. And she was dead serious.
“Hi, I’mSandra Bullock, and I’m not gonna lie. There arealienships flying around the sky. I’ve seen them, and I’m so happy the government has finally corroborated my story, so I no longer feel like an insane person,” she said in the promovideofor her appearance on theNot Gonna Liepodcast.
Bullock said that she saw the UFO after filming in Saint Martin. After the day’s production was completed, “and a bunch of us went out, so there were a couple of beers involved, and we were all lying on the sand.”
When Bullock first saw a single point of light, she assumed it was a satellite. Then she saw other lights emerge from various directions, culminating in five lights converging.
“I’m watching it, and then there’s another little light that comes from a different direction to meet that light. And I went, Hmm, two satellites,” she continued, adding, “And then there was another light, and another light. There was five all together, and they all came together.”
Sandra Bullock saw something she cannot explain
Naturally, while it was an odd sighting, Bullock didn’t think the lights might beUFOs. At least at first.
“And then all of a sudden, poof, they just took off like that,” Bullock said. “And so you look around, going, ‘Anybody else see that?’ I think one of the other people had seen it as well.”
Sandra Bullock said she hadn’t really told anyone about the UFO sighting until thePentagon started releasing its UFO files.
“I was just quiet about it until the government released the documents, and that exact formation was alsoseen by legitimate pilots,” she said. “So I feel vindicated.”
“I do firmly believe there’s life; we can’t be the only ones, we can’t be,” host Kylie Kelce told Bullock.
“I think they’re here,” Bullock replied. “I think they’re here watching and laughing, but they’re invisible.”
articles.title_cn: 桑德拉·布洛克称目击UFO后确信隐形外星人正在“注视并嘲笑”我们
articles.summary_cn: 桑德拉·布洛克表示，一次UFO目击经历让她确信隐形外星人正在“注视并嘲笑”我们。而且她是认真的。
articles.body_cn:
桑德拉·布洛克表示，一次UFO目击经历让她确信隐形外星人正在“注视并嘲笑”我们。而且她是认真的。

“嗨，我是桑德拉·布洛克，我不想撒谎。天空中有外星飞船在飞。我亲眼见过它们，我很高兴政府终于证实了我的说法，这样我就不再觉得自己是个疯子了。”她在为参加《Not Gonna Lie》播客节目录制的宣传视频中说道。

布洛克说，她是在圣马丁岛拍摄结束后看到UFO的。当天的拍摄工作完成后，“我们一群人出去了，喝了几瓶啤酒，然后都躺在沙滩上。”

布洛克最初看到一个光点时，以为那是一颗卫星。随后她看到其他光点从不同方向出现，最终五个光点汇聚在一起。

“我看着它，然后另一个小光点从不同方向飞过来与那个光点会合。我想，嗯，两颗卫星，”她继续说道，“然后又一个光点，再来一个。总共有五个，它们都聚到了一起。”

桑德拉·布洛克看到了她无法解释的东西

当然，虽然这是一次奇怪的目击，布洛克起初并没有想到那些光点可能是UFO。至少一开始没有。

“然后突然间，噗的一声，它们就那样飞走了，”布洛克说，“于是你环顾四周，心想：‘有人也看到了吗？’我觉得同行的人中有人也看到了。”

桑德拉·布洛克说，在五角大楼开始公布UFO文件之前，她几乎没有告诉过任何人这次UFO目击事件。

“我一直保持沉默，直到政府公布了那些文件，而且那种确切的编队也被正规飞行员看到过，”她说，“所以我觉得自己得到了平反。”

“我坚信存在其他生命；我们不可能是唯一的，绝对不可能，”主持人凯莉·凯尔斯对布洛克说。

“我认为它们就在这里，”布洛克回答，“我认为它们就在这里注视着我们，嘲笑着我们，但它们是隐形的。”

articles.title: FAA Records Detail Pilot Encounter with Unidentified Object Pacing Aircraft Over Nevada
articles.summary: A newly released set of Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) records, obtained through the Freedom of Information Act (FOIA), documents an unusual aerial encounter involving a business jet over Northern Nevada in May 2025. The records include air traffic control (ATC) audio and internal FAA logs, though key data, specifically radar information, was withheld. The FOIA [...] The post FAA Records De
articles.body:
A newly released set of Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) records, obtained through the Freedom of Information Act (FOIA), documents an unusual aerial encounter involving a business jet over Northern Nevada in May 2025. The records include air traffic control (ATC) audio and internal FAA logs, though key data, specifically radar information, was withheld.
The FOIA request, originally submitted May 30, 2025, sought comprehensive records related to an Unidentified Anomalous Phenomenon (UAP) observed by flight PWA192 during its return trip from San Francisco International Airport (SFO) to Chicago Executive Airport (PWK). The FAA issued a partial denial response under case number FAA-2025-03957, releasing limited material while withholding others under federal exemptions.
The case first came to light through an anonymous tip submitted to The Black Vault. While anonymous sources are typically treated with caution, the details provided were corroborated through FAA documentation and audio recordings released under FOIA.
The most direct official acknowledgment appears in the FAA’sDaily Record of Facility Operation(Form 7230-4), which documents the event as it was recorded in real time by Oakland Air Route Traffic Control Center (ZOA).
At approximately 0210 UTC, the log states:
This entry establishes several key facts: the object was visually observed, it appeared aircraft-like, it maintained a parallel course, and it was not detected on radar systems available to controllers.
Audio transcripts from Oakland Center sectors provide a more detailed and dynamic description of the object as observed by the flight crew and discussed with controllers.
Initial descriptions suggested a “black circle” or object with possible wing-like features. As the encounter progressed, the characterization shifted. At one point, the object was described as resembling “some sort of fighter,” aligning with the wording later used in the FAA’s official log.
The object reportedly maintained position alongside the aircraft for an extended period of approximately 100 miles while pacing the jet at cruise altitude. This sustained proximity is notable, as it implies controlled flight behavior rather than a transient or incidental sighting.
The encounter concluded with the object rapidly ascending and disappearing from view. This abrupt vertical departure was emphasized in the communications, distinguishing the object’s behavior from conventional aircraft operating profiles.
While the FAA log provides a concise summary, the ATC audio reveals a broader range of uncertainty and evolving interpretation among those involved.
The official entry frames the object as “similar to a fighter,” whereas real-time communications included more ambiguous descriptors, including references to unusual shape and unclear configuration. The progression from an undefined “black” object to something potentially resembling a military aircraft highlights how interpretation shifted during the event.
Flight PW
articles.title_cn: FAA记录详述飞行员在内华达州北部遭遇不明物体与飞机并行的经过
articles.summary_cn: 通过《信息自由法》获得的一组新公布的联邦航空管理局（FAA）记录，记录了2025年5月一架商务机在内华达州北部上空遭遇的一次不寻常空中事件。记录包括空中交通管制（ATC）音频和FAA内部日志，但关键数据（特别是雷达信息）被扣留。
articles.body_cn:
通过《信息自由法》（FOIA）获得的一组新公布的联邦航空管理局（FAA）记录，记录了2025年5月一架商务机在内华达州北部上空遭遇的一次不寻常空中事件。记录包括空中交通管制（ATC）音频和FAA内部日志，但关键数据（特别是雷达信息）被扣留。

该FOIA请求最初于2025年5月30日提交，旨在获取与航班PWA192从旧金山国际机场（SFO）返回芝加哥行政机场（PWK）途中观察到不明异常现象（UAP）相关的全面记录。FAA以案件编号FAA-2025-03957发布了部分拒绝回应，在联邦豁免条款下释放了有限材料，同时扣留了其他材料。

此案最初通过提交给The Black Vault的匿名线索曝光。虽然匿名来源通常需要谨慎对待，但所提供细节已通过FAA文件和根据FOIA发布的音频记录得到证实。

最直接的官方确认出现在FAA的《设施日常运行记录》（表格7230-4）中，该文件记录了奥克兰航路交通管制中心（ZOA）实时记录的事件。

大约在协调世界时02:10，日志记载：

该条目确立了几个关键事实：该物体被目视观察到，外观类似飞机，保持平行航向，且未被管制员可用的雷达系统探测到。

来自奥克兰中心各扇区的音频记录提供了机组人员观察到并与管制员讨论的物体的更详细、更动态的描述。

最初的描述暗示了一个“黑色圆形”或可能带有翼状特征的物体。随着遭遇的推进，描述特征发生了变化。在某一时刻，该物体被描述为类似“某种战斗机”，这与后来FAA官方日志中使用的措辞一致。

据报道，该物体保持了相对位置……

articles.title: Archive of Luis Elizondo’s “Deleted” Emails
articles.summary: Luis Elizondo has become a central figure in the modern discourse surrounding Unidentified Aerial Phenomena (UAP) due to his alleged involvement with the Pentagon’s Advanced Aerospace Threat Identification Program (AATIP). His revelations and subsequent claims have been both groundbreaking and controversial, fueling numerous debates regarding the U.S. government’s engagement with UAPs. In an unpre
articles.body:
Luis Elizondo has become a central figure in the modern discourse surrounding Unidentified Aerial Phenomena (UAP) due to his alleged involvement with the Pentagon’sAdvanced Aerospace Threat Identification Program(AATIP). His revelations and subsequent claims have been both groundbreaking and controversial, fueling numerous debates regarding the U.S. government’s engagement with UAPs.
In an unprecedented revelation, The Black Vault was the first to report that the Department of Defense (DoD) haddestroyed Elizondo’s emails, a move that surprised many and intensified the scrutiny surrounding the government’s handling of this sensitive subject. It also hindered efforts to verify many of Elizondo’s claims, with the use of what would likely reside in these emails. Therefore, this presented a significant barrier to the standard Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) process while investigating his claims.
Yet, where one door closed, another opened.
Recognizing that communication is a two-way process, The Black Vault initiated a strategic approach. By targeting FOIA requests on the email archives of DoD personnel who had likely corresponded with Elizondo, it was possible to indirectly recover portions of Elizondo’s email exchanges. This indirect method, albeit unorthodox, proved to be a way to shed light on conversations that would have otherwise remained obscured.
The archive below,which is still being added to due to the fact that numerous FOIA requests are still open,is a collection of emails offering a glimpse into the world of Luis Elizondo and his interactions within the Department of Defense. In addition, it also logs those that may have communicated with Elizondo, but according to the FOIA final response, ‘no records’ were found. That is archived here as the inability to find records can be used to fact check claims in the past made.
Mark Sanders[3 Pages, 1MB] – It is likely that Mr. Mark Sanders was the Director of the Foreign Material Program at the time Luis Elizondo stated he briefed him on AATIP, as claimed by Elizondo’s IG complaint, as published by the NY Post. Although the name was redacted, a DoD resource indicates Sanders was likely in that position.
A request was filed, but it was determined through the processing of the FOIA case that Sanders’ emails were destroyed after he left the DoD in 2017. Therefore, a “no records” determination was given.
articles.title_cn: 路易斯·埃利松多“被删除”电子邮件档案
articles.summary_cn: 路易斯·埃利松多因其据称参与五角大楼“先进航空航天威胁识别计划”（AATIP）而成为现代不明空中现象（UAP）讨论的核心人物。他的爆料和后续主张既具有开创性又充满争议，引发了关于美国政府与UAP接触的无数辩论。
articles.body_cn:
路易斯·埃利松多因其据称参与五角大楼“先进航空航天威胁识别计划”（AATIP）而成为现代不明空中现象（UAP）讨论的核心人物。他的爆料和后续主张既具有开创性又充满争议，引发了关于美国政府与UAP接触的无数辩论。

在一项前所未有的披露中，The Black Vault率先报道了国防部（DoD）销毁了埃利松多的电子邮件，这一举动令许多人感到惊讶，并加剧了人们对政府处理这一敏感话题方式的审视。这也阻碍了验证埃利松多许多主张的努力，因为验证工作本应依赖这些邮件中的内容。因此，这为在调查其主张时通过标准《信息自由法》（FOIA）程序设置了重大障碍。

然而，一扇门关闭，另一扇门打开了。

认识到沟通是双向的过程，The Black Vault启动了一种策略性方法。通过将FOIA请求瞄准那些可能与埃利松多有过通信的国防部人员的电子邮件档案，有可能间接恢复埃利松多电子邮件交流的部分内容。这种间接方法虽然非常规，但被证明是揭示那些原本会被掩盖的对话的一种途径。

下面的档案（由于众多FOIA请求仍在处理中，该档案仍在持续增加中）是一个电子邮件合集，让我们得以一窥路易斯·埃利松多的世界及其在国防部内部的互动。此外，它还记录了那些可能与埃利松多有过通信、但根据FOIA最终回应“未找到记录”的人员。这些信息也被存档于此，因为无法找到记录这一事实本身可用于核实过去提出的主张。

马克·桑德斯[3页，1MB]——马克·桑德斯先生很可能在路易斯·埃利松多……时期担任外国物资项目主任。

articles.title: What Timothy Gallaudet’s NOAA Emails Reveal About His Interest in UAPs
articles.summary: A newly released Freedom of Information Act response from the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration offers a limited but useful look at UAP-related keyword hits found in the email records of Dr. Timothy Gallaudet, the former Assistant Secretary of Commerce for Oceans and Atmosphere, Acting Under Secretary of Commerce for Oceans and Atmosphere, Acting NOAA [...] The post What Timothy Gall
articles.body:
A newly released Freedom of Information Act response from theNational Oceanic and Atmospheric Administrationoffers a limited but useful look at UAP-related keyword hits found in the email records ofDr. Timothy Gallaudet, the former Assistant Secretary of Commerce for Oceans and Atmosphere, Acting Under Secretary of Commerce for Oceans and Atmosphere, Acting NOAA Administrator, and Deputy NOAA Administrator.
The request, filed July 10, 2023, sought all emails sent to, from, or copied to Gallaudet between October 25, 2017, and January 20, 2021, that contained a series of UFO- and UAP-related terms. Those terms included “UNIDENTIFIED AERIAL,” “UNIDENTIFIED ANOMALOUS,” “AARO” (included even though AARO pre-dated date range), “UAP,” “UAPTF,” “UFO,” “UNIDENTIFIED FLYING,” “AOIMSG,” “ELIZONDO,” and “GRUSCH.” Those dates were chosen as they coincided with his time at NOAA. A second FOIA request was filed with the Navy, which is still open.
NOAA’s final response, dated May 6, 2026, stated that the agency located 51 responsive records totaling 245 pages. According to the agency, 167 pages were released in full, while 78 pages were released with redactions under FOIA exemption (b)(6), which protects personal privacy. NOAA stated the request was complete.
While the release does not reveal extensive government discussions about UAP programs, it does provide a glimpse into the information ecosystem surrounding the issue and the material that was reaching Gallaudet during his time at NOAA.
Among the more notable records are emails connected to the Unidentified Aerial Phenomena Task Force (UAPTF).
In an August 17, 2020 email, Gallaudet wrote, “I told you that I’m on another Interagency ESC chaired by the chair of this TF – ONI’s CO. I will!” The reference appears to indicate that Gallaudet was serving on a separate interagency Executive Steering Committee (ESC) chaired by the same Office of Naval Intelligence official who was leading the UAP Task Force at the time. While the email does not suggest that Gallaudet himself was a member of the UAPTF, it does show an awareness of the task force and a professional connection to its leadership through another government coordination mechanism. His email stated that he “will” get answers to the UAP issue, given his connections to its top leadership.
During the period in question, the UAP Task Force was at the Office of Naval Intelligence, then led by Rear Adm. Kelly Aeschbach.
Aeschbach and Gallaudet were not strangers to one another. Both had previously served in senior Navy leadership positions, according to Gallaudet’s email.
While the released records do not indicate that Gallaudet participated in the UAP Task Force itself, his August 2020 email suggests he was clearly familiar with its leadership and had professional access to the same senior official overseeing the effort through a separate interagency Executive Steering Committee (ESC). articles.title_cn: 蒂莫西·加劳德特的NOAA电子邮件揭示了他对UAP的兴趣
articles.summary_cn: 美国国家海洋和大气管理局新公布的一份《信息自由法》回应，提供了对蒂莫西·加劳德特博士电子邮件记录中UAP相关关键词命中情况的有限但有用的观察。加劳德特曾任海洋和大气事务助理商务部长、海洋和大气事务代理副部长、NOAA代理局长及NOAA副局长。
articles.body_cn:
美国国家海洋和大气管理局（NOAA）新公布的一份《信息自由法》（FOIA）回应，提供了对蒂莫西·加劳德特博士电子邮件记录中UAP相关关键词命中情况的有限但有用的观察。加劳德特曾任海洋和大气事务助理商务部长、海洋和大气事务代理副部长、NOAA代理局长及NOAA副局长。

该请求于2023年7月10日提交，寻求获取2017年10月25日至2021年1月20日期间发送给加劳德特、由他发送或抄送给他、且包含一系列UFO和UAP相关术语的所有电子邮件。这些术语包括“UNIDENTIFIED AERIAL”（不明空中）、“UNIDENTIFIED ANOMALOUS”（不明异常）、“AARO”（尽管AARO早于该日期范围仍被纳入）、“UAP”、“UAPTF”、“UFO”、“UNIDENTIFIED FLYING”（不明飞行）、“AOIMSG”、“ELIZONDO”（埃利松多）和“GRUSCH”（格鲁施）。选择这些日期是因为它们与他在NOAA任职的时间吻合。第二个FOIA请求已提交给海军，目前仍在处理中。

NOAA于2026年5月6日做出的最终回应称，该机构找到了51份相关记录，共245页。据该机构称，167页全文公开，78页根据FOIA豁免条款(b)(6)（保护个人隐私）进行了删节后公开。NOAA表示该请求已处理完毕。

虽然此次公开并未揭示政府关于UAP项目的广泛讨论，但它确实让我们得以一窥围绕该问题的信息生态系统，以及在加劳德特任职NOAA期间传递到他手中的材料。

在较值得注意的记录中，有与不明空中现象特别工作组（UAPTF）相关的电子邮件。

在2020年8月17日的一封电子邮件中，加劳德特写道：“我告诉过你，我在另一个跨部门ESC任职，主席是该TF的主席——ONI的CO。我会的！”该引用似乎表明，加劳德特当时正在一个由领导UAP特别工作组的同一位海军情报局官员主持的独立跨部门执行指导委员会（ESC）中任职。虽然该电子邮件……

articles.title: What is the Electronic Reading Room?
articles.summary: Welcome to the Central Intelligence Agency's Freedom of Information Act Electronic Reading Room.
articles.summary_cn: 欢迎来到中央情报局《信息自由法》电子阅览室。
articles.body_cn:
中央情报局（CIA）《信息自由法》电子阅览室是该机构根据《信息自由法》要求而设立的在线资料库，旨在向公众提供已解密或可公开获取的政府文件。作为美国情报体系的重要组成部分，CIA定期通过该平台发布涉及历史事件、情报行动、科技发展等主题的档案材料，以满足公众对政府透明度的需求。

电子阅览室通常收录了经过审查后被认为可以公开的各类文件，包括但不限于历史情报报告、政策备忘录、研究报告等。研究人员、记者和普通公众均可通过该平台免费访问这些资料，从而加深对美国情报工作历史与现状的了解。

值得注意的是，并非所有CIA文件都会在电子阅览室中公开。涉及国家安全、情报来源与方法等敏感信息的内容通常会根据FOIA豁免条款予以保护。尽管如此，电子阅览室仍然是公众获取CIA历史档案的重要渠道之一。

articles.title: Sandra Bullock recalls bizarre UFO sighting that left her convinced aliens exist: 'I no longer feel like an insane person'
articles.summary: Sandra Bullock recalled a bizarre UFO sighting in Saint Martin that made her believe aliens do exist.
articles.title_cn: 桑德拉·布洛克回忆在圣马丁岛遭遇的离奇UFO事件，坚信外星人存在：“我不再觉得自己是个疯子”
articles.summary_cn: 桑德拉·布洛克回忆起在圣马丁岛遭遇的一次离奇UFO目击事件，这次经历让她相信外星人确实存在。
articles.body_cn:
好莱坞影星桑德拉·布洛克近日在播客节目中公开回忆了她在加勒比海圣马丁岛拍摄期间经历的一次离奇UFO目击事件。据布洛克描述，当天拍摄结束后，她与几位同行人员在沙滩上休息时，夜空中先后出现了多个光点从不同方向汇聚，最终五个光点聚拢在一起后突然以极快速度消失。

布洛克表示，她最初以为看到的是卫星，但光点的异常编队和突然加速令她意识到事情并不寻常。她坦言，多年来她一直对此事保持沉默，直到五角大楼陆续公布UFO相关文件，其中提到正规飞行员也曾观察到类似编队，她才感到自己的经历得到了印证。

“我坚信宇宙中存在其他生命，我们绝不可能是唯一的，”布洛克在节目中说道。她认为外星生命可能就在我们身边，只是以隐形的方式存在，“它们正在注视着我们，嘲笑着我们。”
